title: Jubilant Fluffy Indian Corn Biryani
description: A cultured and fluffy Indian dish featuring corn flour and fermented jang, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients to create a romantic and satisfying meal. This dish is perfect for special occasions or cozy nights in.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes before draining and setting aside.
Heat the ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat and add the cumin seeds, letting them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the turmeric powder and salt, stirring to combine, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked and drained rice to the saucepan, stirring to combine with the spice mixture, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the corn flour and fermented jang to the saucepan, stirring to combine, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Simmer the biryani for 20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is fluffy and tender.
Turn off the heat and let the biryani rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
